From today, Runna subscription users can use the new "Heat Adaptation" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna launches training tool designed for hot weather

Personal running coach app Runna today announced three updates aimed at supporting users throughout their entire training cycle, from training in hot weather to post-race recovery — everything you need in one place.

The new "Heat Adaptation" feature launches today, and Runna will help users identify cooler running timeslots, and recommend adjusted pace targets based on felt air temperature, training duration, and specific sessions.

The "Heat Adaptation" feature will display an hourly weather forecast colour-coded by the hour, allowing users to quickly grasp the most suitable times for running, so they can plan accordingly.

Here's Runna's introduction to the new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature — as soon as a user launches a race plan ranging from 5K to 50K, the system automatically generates a relevant plan. Runna Head Coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce wear and tear or risk of injury."

Lastly, the platform also announced a new feature called "Future Plans" set to launch in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans, and seamlessly transition automatically to the next one when a plan ends, further streamlining long-term training workflows.

Here's Runna's introduction to the advantages of the "Future Plans" feature:

Plan your year of training in minutes: Runners can stack races, phase goals, and training cycles together for a clear overview of the entire year. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch — your preferred training schedule, predicted race times, and current fitness level carry over automatically after your current plan ends. Flexible and fully in your control: Every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, so runners remain in complete command of their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is designed by Runna's senior coaching team based on established training principles, supporting sustainable progression, recovery, and race-day preparation.
